title: HEAD E-COMMERCE
description:
**Role Description** 
 The Head E\-Commerce is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Kottayam, responsible for leading and growing Oxygen’s online retail business. The role involves defining and executing the e\-commerce strategy, managing the online product catalog, pricing, promotions, and customer experience across digital channels. The Head E\-Commerce will collaborate with sales, marketing, and operations teams to integrate online and offline initiatives, drive traffic, optimize conversion rates, and improve overall revenue and profitability. Daily tasks include analyzing performance data, overseeing digital campaigns, coordinating with brand partners, supervising platform enhancements, and ensuring timely execution of online orders and customer service standards. This role also requires mentoring a cross\-functional team, monitoring market trends, and identifying new opportunities for digital growth.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Strong E\-Commerce and Business Planning skills to design, implement, and scale online retail strategies.
* Proficient Marketing and Sales skills to drive traffic, engagement, and revenue across digital and physical channels.
* Advanced Analytical Skills to interpret data, optimize conversion funnels, manage budgets, and support decision\-making.
* Experience in managing online marketplaces, brand websites, or omnichannel retail environments.
* Proven leadership and team management capabilities, with the ability to coordinate cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, E\-Commerce, or a related field; a master’s degree or relevant certifications are an advantage.
* Prior experience in consumer electronics or digital products retail is highly beneficial.

title: Platform Management Executive
description:
We are looking for a
 **Platform Management Executive** 
 to manage and maintain product and seller\-related activities on our e\-commerce marketplace. The role involves product listing, seller coordination, product verification, category and brand management, and ensuring accurate and high\-quality information across the platform.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Manage and update product listings on the e\-commerce platform.
* Coordinate with sellers regarding product information, documents, images, pricing, and listing requirements.
* Review and verify product details before publishing them on the platform.
* Manage product categories, brands, attributes, and marketplace data.
* Identify and resolve product listing errors, content issues, and platform\-related discrepancies.
* Coordinate with sellers to collect missing or incorrect product information.
* Maintain accuracy and consistency of product titles, descriptions, specifications, images, and other listing details.
* Monitor marketplace products and ensure compliance with platform guidelines.
* Support seller onboarding by assisting with product uploads and listing\-related requirements.
* Coordinate with Customer Support, Relations, Development, and other internal teams to resolve platform\-related issues.
* Track daily and weekly product management activities and meet assigned productivity targets.
* Identify recurring platform or listing issues and communicate them to the concerned team for resolution.



**Requirements:** 



* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification.
* Good understanding of e\-commerce platforms and product listing processes.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Freshers with a strong interest in e\-commerce and platform management can apply



  





**Work Mode :Hybrid** 




**Salary : 10k to 13k**

title: IoT Architect
description:
**Kerala Vision Broadband Limited** 
 is seeking an experienced
 **IoT Architect** 
 to join our
 **Solution Engineering – IoT \& Digital Solutions Team** 
 and drive next\-generation IoT, Smart City, and Digital Transformation initiatives.
 



 📍
 **Location:** 
 Ernakulam / Thrissur
 



 💼
 **Experience:** 
 8–14 Years
 



 🏢
 **Department:** 
 Solution Engineering – IoT \& Digital Solutions Practice
   




 ◆ Role Overview
 
 The IoT Architect is a broad\-spectrum technology strategist responsible for designing end\-to\-end IoT solutions across devices, connectivity, edge computing, cloud platforms, and application layers. As Kerala Vision expands its Managed Services \& System Integration (MSI) business, IoT is a key growth area covering Smart Cities, Industrial IoT, Smart Metering, Fleet Management, Healthcare IoT, and Building Management Systems.
 


 ◆ Key Responsibilities
 * Design end\-to\-end IoT architectures covering device, connectivity, edge, cloud, and application layers.
* Architect solutions using AWS IoT, Azure IoT, Google Cloud IoT, ThingsBoard, and similar platforms.
* Develop Smart City and Industrial IoT (IIoT) solutions for enterprise and government customers.
* Design IoT security frameworks including device identity, OTA updates, and secure communications.
* Support technical pre\-sales activities including customer presentations, solution proposals, BoQs, and RFP/RFI responses.
* Leverage ISP connectivity assets such as NB\-IoT, LTE\-M, eSIM, and APN services to build innovative solutions.
* Engage with OEMs, technology partners, and industry stakeholders to deliver best\-in\-class IoT solutions.



  




 ◆ Educational Qualification
 
 🎓 B.E./B.Tech in Electronics \& Communication, Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecommunications, or related disciplines.
 



 🎓 MCA / M.Sc. (IT/Networks) with relevant industry experience may also be considered.
 



 🎓 M.Tech / MBA (Technology Management) will be an added advantage.
 



  




 ◆ What We're Looking For
 
 ✔ Proven experience in designing and delivering end\-to\-end IoT solutions.
 



 ✔ Strong understanding of IoT connectivity, cloud platforms, edge computing, analytics, and security.
 



 ✔ Excellent customer\-facing, pre\-sales, and solution presentation skills.
 



 ✔ Ability to translate complex technical architectures into business\-focused solutions.
 



  





 📩 Interested candidates may send their updated resume to:
 



 careers@keralavisionisp.com
